segments.motivation: To gain clear visibility into project progress, team workloads, and resource allocation to ensure projects stay on track and meet deadlines.
To clearly understand their assigned tasks, priorities, and deadlines, and to collaborate effectively with teammates without constant manual updates.
To achieve strategic oversight, connect daily work to overarching company objectives, and automate workflows to drive organizational efficiency.

tasks.purpose: into bite-size pieces with clear owners and due dates
such as lists, calendars, timelines, Gantt charts, or Kanban boards
to improve efficiency and focus on higher-value work
to measure productivity and inform resource planning
and report on project status and team performance with real-time data

benefits.claim: It improves team collaboration and provides comprehensive visibility into all work and project statuses.
It significantly reduces time spent on manual status updates and reporting through automation and real-time insights.
It helps connect daily tasks and team efforts directly to broader company goals and objectives.

frictions.claim: The extensive feature set can be overwhelming for new users or smaller teams trying to get started.
Advanced functionalities, integrations, or specific views might be restricted to higher-tier paid plans.
Initial setup and customization for complex workflows or larger organizations can be time-consuming.

unknowns: The practical utility and performance of the AI Teammates and AI agents in real-world team workflows.
The user experience and effectiveness of the 'Work Graph' technology in providing shared context and memory.
The balance between core features available in free/lower tiers versus premium plans and how this affects user satisfaction.
